task: Task 1: Freeze the comparison inputs and baseline
purpose: Immutable experiment inputs shared by every Epic 014 GLiNER2.5 run and by the Epic 013 LLM baseline re-score. All three GLiNER2.5 checkpoints (fastino/gliner2.5-small-v1, fastino/gliner2.5-base-v1, fastino/gliner2.5-multi-v1) and the baseline must be scored against exactly these files.

immutability_policy.rule: Files in this directory are frozen experiment inputs. Never edit, re-serialize, or overwrite them. All files are chmod 444 and directories 555. Derived artifacts (baseline re-scores, model runs, reports) must be written elsewhere: model runs to experiments/open-vocab-graph/gliner-runs/ (Task 3+), and any regenerated input requires a NEW versioned directory plus an explicit epic note; never in place.
immutability_policy.verification: Run `python3 check_inputs.py` (any Python >= 3.9, stdlib only) before relying on these inputs or inspecting new model output. It re-verifies every sha256 below, all source-line expectations (AGENTS.md line 7, reference-set evidence passages, test-input quotes), and seed content fingerprints.
immutability_policy.hash_algorithms: sha256 recorded as the primary integrity check and is what check_inputs.py re-verifies (Python stdlib). xxh3-64 (xxhash-rust 0.8, the same algorithm the Epic 013 harness used) is recorded as provenance cross-reference so these artifacts can be matched against Epic 013 run manifests; xxh3 values were computed at freeze time with a standalone xxhash-rust 0.8 helper, not re-computed by check_inputs.py.

AGENTS.md.role: Source snapshot: the single text corpus every model extracts from. Character offsets and line citations must resolve against this copy.
AGENTS.md.origin: Repo-root AGENTS.md at freeze time (git working tree, uncommitted state). Verified byte-identical (diff) to the snapshot stored by every Epic 013 extraction run: output/runs/budget-{150,250,400,600}/snapshots/AGENTS.md, and to the snapshot recorded in output/reference-set.json source.sha256.
AGENTS.md.line_7_expectation: Line 7 (1-based) is the R1/R2/R3 evidence line: 'daftprompt is a Rust app for exploring text repositories (git repos, document folders) via an infinite-canvas, card-based UI. It uses **akar** (a GPU UI component library on wgpu + glyphon + taffy) for rendering, combined with a git commit reader (gitoxide) and a hybrid search indexer (SQLite FTS5 + sqlite-vec embeddings).' The fact 'daftprompt uses akar' is stated here (not as a literal substring; 'It uses **akar**' is the predicate phrase).

reference-set.json.role: Scoring ground truth recorded before any extraction run existed: 9 supported relations (R1-R9) with verbatim expected passages, 8 repeated entities with occurrence lines, 6 questions (Q5, Q6 expect 'unknown').
reference-set.json.origin: Epic 013 Task 3 pre-extraction reference set (experiments/open-vocab-graph/output/reference-set.json, recorded_at 2026-09-28T07:04:12Z, recorded_before_any_extraction_run=true). Its content hash 7dad11a105072baf matches the reference_set_content_hash recorded in all four Epic 013 run manifests, and the copy is byte-identical to output/runs/budget-250/reference-set.json.
reference-set.json.note: Expected evidence texts are complete physical lines copied verbatim from the frozen AGENTS.md; the checker re-validates every one against the frozen snapshot.

seed-vocabulary.json.role: The one chosen discovered seed. Task 2 converts THIS seed into the versioned GLiNER2.5 schema; the LLM baseline (budget-250) ran under exactly this seed.
seed-vocabulary.json.origin: Epic 013 Task 2 consolidation output (experiments/open-vocab-graph/output/seed-vocabulary.json): a second `open-vocab-graph consolidate` LLM pass (model mimo-v2.5-pro) over the re-sampled proposed vocabulary, recorded in output/consolidation-log.json with zero merges (input 4 entity kinds / 4 predicates, output identical; no_merge_rationale present). Consumed the same day by the Epic 013 budget-250 extraction run, whose run-manifest.json records seed_content_hash c776d7e579d8aed5 - exactly this file's xxh3-64, re-verified at freeze time.
seed-vocabulary.json.why_this_seed: Three Epic 013 runs (budgets 150/400/600) used an EARLIER, different seed (xxh3 9bd9ffae74304ce2: kinds CLI/Database/Model/SearchIndex/DataSource, uses=CLI->Database; it survives only as re-serialized copies inside those run directories, the top-level file having been overwritten by the later consolidation). The budget-250 run used THIS seed, under which the motivating Epic 014 failure occurred: `daftprompt uses akar` was emitted at AGENTS.md line 7 and rejected (model typed daftprompt as Tool while seed `uses` is Command->Tool, and its citation quoted only part of line 7 - see output/runs/budget-250/invalid-claims.json b1). Freezing this seed makes the LLM baseline and all GLiNER2.5 runs same-seed, and Task 2's schema repair (add Application kind + uses(Application, Tool) pair) is a controlled change against exactly the seed that failed.

stale_result_warning: Epic 013's report table column 'budget 250' (31 valid claims, seed 9bd9ffae74304ce2) does NOT describe output/runs/budget-250/ (40 valid claims, seed c776d7e579d8aed5). Never compare any Epic 014 result with that stale column. The actual folder is re-scored in llm-baseline/budget-250-rescore.json and is the only LLM baseline.

derived_artifacts.comparison-plan.md: Which LLM run is the baseline and how its schema differs from the GLiNER2.5 schema.
derived_artifacts.test-inputs.json: Targeted positive/negative test inputs: the AGENTS.md line 7 case plus per-reference-fact (R1-R9) examples; every quote is re-verified against the frozen snapshot by check_inputs.py.
derived_artifacts.llm-baseline/budget-250-rescore.json: Support/misleading re-score of the actual budget-250 folder (40 validated claims) under this frozen seed, with mechanical citation re-verification.
derived_artifacts.llm-baseline/budget-250-rescore.md: Human-readable baseline scorecard (support counts, R1-R9 recovery, question coverage).
derived_artifacts.check_inputs.py: Stdlib-only verifier described above; run it before looking at new model output.
derived_artifacts.check-inputs-run-2026-09-28.log: Output of the pre-model-output verification run performed in Task 1.
